LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO,
MAX(IMAGE_PATH) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_MAIN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, IMAGE_NO ) AS MAIN_IMAGE
FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE
GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) PI ON PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO

WHERE P.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
AND ( LOWER(P.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR LOWER(B.BUSINESS_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR LOWER(C.TITLE) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR LOWER(A.ACTOR_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
AND P.PRODUCT_TYPE IN
#{productType}
AND FLOOR( P.PRICE * ( 100 - NVL(P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0) ) / 100 ) >= #{minPrice}
AND FLOOR( P.PRICE * ( 100 - NVL(P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0) ) / 100 ) <= #{maxPrice}
AND NVL(P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0) > 0
AND NVL(P.STOCK, 0) > 0
mapper.select:
SELECT PAGED.PRODUCT_NO, PAGED.BUSINESS_NO, PAGED.CONTENT_NO, PAGED.ACTOR_NO, PAGED.PRODUCT_NAME, PAGED.PRODUCT_TYPE, PAGED.PRICE, PAGED.DISCOUNT_RATE, PAGED.STOCK, PAGED.DESCRIPTION, PAGED.STATUS, PAGED.BUSINESS_NAME, PAGED.MAIN_IMAGE
FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{type} = 'popular' AND NVL(P.STOCK, 0) > 0 THEN 0 WHEN #{type} = 'popular' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{type} = 'popular' THEN NVL(P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0) ELSE 0 END DESC, P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC ) AS RN,
P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, NVL( P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0 ) AS DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL( P.STOCK, 0 ) AS STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, B.BUSINESS_NAME, PI.MAIN_IMAGE
FROM PRODUCT P
INNER JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
INNER JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO
LEFT JOIN ACTOR A ON A.ACTOR_NO = P.ACTOR_NO
) PAGED
WHERE PAGED.RN BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
ORDER BY PAGED.RN

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM PRODUCT P
INNER JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
INNER JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO
LEFT JOIN ACTOR A ON A.ACTOR_NO = P.ACTOR_NO

SELECT RECOMMENDED.PRODUCT_NO, RECOMMENDED.BUSINESS_NO, RECOMMENDED.CONTENT_NO, RECOMMENDED.ACTOR_NO, RECOMMENDED.PRODUCT_NAME, RECOMMENDED.PRODUCT_TYPE, RECOMMENDED.PRICE, RECOMMENDED.DISCOUNT_RATE, RECOMMENDED.STOCK, RECOMMENDED.DESCRIPTION, RECOMMENDED.STATUS, RECOMMENDED.BUSINESS_NAME, RECOMMENDED.MAIN_IMAGE
FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY CASE WHEN NVL(P.STOCK, 0) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, NVL(P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0) DESC, P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC ) AS RN,
P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, NVL( P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0 ) AS DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL( P.STOCK, 0 ) AS STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, B.BUSINESS_NAME, PI.MAIN_IMAGE
FROM PRODUCT P
INNER JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
WHERE P.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
) RECOMMENDED
WHERE RECOMMENDED.RN BETWEEN 1 AND #{limit}
ORDER BY RECOMMENDED.RN

SELECT DISTINCT P.PRODUCT_TYPE
FROM PRODUCT P
WHERE P.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND P.PRODUCT_TYPE IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_TYPE

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, NVL( P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0 ) AS DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL( P.STOCK, 0 ) AS STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, B.BUSINESS_NAME, PI.MAIN_IMAGE
FROM PRODUCT P
INNER JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND P.STATUS = 'APPROVED'

SELECT PI.IMAGE_NO AS "imageNo", PI.PRODUCT_NO AS "productNo", PI.IMAGE_PATH AS "imagePath", PI.IS_MAIN AS "isMain"
FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI
INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = PI.PRODUCT_NO
WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND P.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, PI.IMAGE_NO

SELECT C.CONTENT_NO AS "contentNo", C.TITLE AS "title", C.POSTER_PATH AS "posterPath", C.CONTENT_TYPE AS "contentType", C.TMDB_SCORE AS "tmdbScore"
FROM PRODUCT P
INNER JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO
WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND P.STATUS = 'APPROVED'

SELECT A.ACTOR_NO AS "actorNo", A.ACTOR_NAME AS "actorName", A.PROFILE_PATH AS "profilePath"
FROM PRODUCT P
INNER JOIN ACTOR A ON A.ACTOR_NO = P.ACTOR_NO
WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND P.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND P.ACTOR_NO IS NOT NULL
